findings.text: follow-on: _refuse_stale_code calls served_code.drift with max_age_s=0.0, so every GET and POST re-stats every package file on the shared filesystem, discarding the reuse window served_code.py:53 was added for.

follow-on: the guard's drift covers the whole package while the server's own report deliberately counts only executed files, so editing a module the running process never touches refuses every request until restart.

follow-on: the disk and running stamps both come from follower_code_stamp, whose file set is cli.py plus crew/*.py and narrower than the drift check, so the pair can read equal on a 503 whose changed_files names a non-crew module.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against 9b66ff8a; reckon/serve.py adds the request guard and code stamp, tests/ adds the reproduction, docs/ adds the landing record.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names a test that changes a module under a running server and a negative control that reproduces the ImportError; tests/test_server_serves_one_code_version.py:26 implements exactly that pair.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that a long-running server never serves a mix of old and new modules; reckon/serve.py:2304 refuses each request once the loaded source has moved on disk.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the 16-file head gate at 1 failed and 194 passed, the base arm at 2 failed, and a negative control that reddens the same test.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths; every path the two commits touch is inside them.

justifications.durability: removing the guard in a scratch copy makes tests/test_server_serves_one_code_version.py:88 fail with the 500 ImportError, which is the regression it guards.
justifications.evidence: base-suite.log records the base ImportError 500 and head-suite.log the 503 at the head revision, and negative-control.log reddens the same test id when the guard is removed.
justifications.fit: reckon/serve.py:2304 follows the Handler idiom but calls drift without the report reuse served_code.py:53 exists to provide.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/serve.py:2304 answers HTTP 503 with error stale-code before any handler can lazily import newer source, the named refusal the section permits.
justifications.scope_discipline: the two commits touch only reckon/serve.py, tests/test_server_serves_one_code_version.py and the evidence fragment, all inside the declared scope.
